source: IS 1893 (Part 1):2016: design horizontal acceleration coefficient Ah = (Z/2)(I/R)(Sa/g) (Clause 6.4.2), the equivalent static (7.6) and dynamic (7.7) methods, drift (7.11)

I.description: Type I: rock or hard soil (well graded gravel, sand-gravel, dense sand; N > 30)

II.description: Type II: medium or stiff soil (poorly graded sand, sand with little fines; N 10-30)

masonryOrdinaryPlain.name: Load bearing masonry walls: unreinforced, without horizontal bands

masonryBands.name: Load bearing masonry walls: unreinforced, with horizontal RC bands

masonryOrdinaryReinforced.name: Load bearing masonry walls: with horizontal RC bands and vertical bars at corners and openings

rcDualOrdinary.name: Dual: ordinary RC structural walls with RC OMRF

rcDualSpecialOrdinaryWalls.name: Dual: ordinary RC structural walls with RC SMRF

rcDualOrdinaryFrameDuctileWalls.name: Dual: ductile RC structural walls with RC OMRF

rcDualSpecial.name: Dual: ductile RC structural walls with RC SMRF

rcFlatSlabWalls.name: Flat slab with RC ductile structural walls (the walls resist all the lateral load)

allowableDriftLabel: All buildings (storey drift of the design lateral force, partial load factor 1.0)

extremeTorsion.label: Torsional irregularity over 1.4: revise the configuration (Table 5 (i))

diaphragmDiscontinuity.label: Floor slabs with excessive cut-outs or openings (Table 5 (iii))

clauses.amplification: Table 5 (i) (no amplification: IS asks for a 3D dynamic analysis)

sources.siteClasses: IS 1893 (Part 1):2016 Table 4 (soil types I, II, III) and Clause 6.4.2: Sa/g = 2.5 up to 0.40 / 0.55 / 0.67 s, then 1.00/T, 1.36/T, 1.67/T to 4 s, constant beyond; TC = 1.36/2.5 = 0.544 s and 1.67/2.5 = 0.668 s make the falling branch the code's (the code's printed plateau end 0.55 / 0.67 s differs by under 1.2 %); S = 1 (the soil enters through TC); TB = 0.10 s: the rising branch 1 + 15T of the response spectrum method
sources.designSpectrum: IS 1893 (Part 1):2016 Clause 6.4.2: Ah = (Z/2)(I/R)(Sa/g); Figure 2(a) (equivalent static: the plateau from T = 0) and 2(b) (response spectrum: 1 + 15T below 0.1 s); Sa/g constant beyond 4 s
sources.systems: IS 1893 (Part 1):2016 Table 9: R of the systems SAEngine models; Cd = R (the displacement estimate of Clause 7.11.3 is R times the elastic one); Ω0 = 2.5 is SAEngine's (IS gives no system overstrength); the ordinary (non-ductile) systems are not permitted in zones III-V (Table 9 note, SAEngine reading), shown as height limit 0 in categories C and D
sources.periodCoefficients: IS 1893 (Part 1):2016 Clause 7.6.2: (a) bare RC moment frame 0.075 h^0.75, bare steel frame 0.085 h^0.75; (c) all other buildings 0.09 h/√d. (b) RC structural wall buildings (the systems of RC walls) 0.075 h^0.75/√Aw >= 0.09 h/√d, Aw = Σ Awi (0.2 + (Lwi/h)²) with Lwi/h at most 0.9, the first storey walls along the shaking (alpha 9 C12)
sources.designCategories: SAEngine practice: IS 1893 has no Seismic Design Category; zone II reads as category B (ordinary detailing permitted) and zones III-V as C (ductile detailing, IS 13920), with 100 % + 30 % only for non-parallel systems
sources.requiredDetailing: IS 13920:2016 Clause 1 (ductile detailing in zones III, IV and V; SAEngine reading)
sources.allowableDrift: IS 1893 (Part 1):2016 Clause 7.11.1.1: storey drift at most 0.004 times the storey height under the design lateral force with partial load factor 1.0
sources.driftAmplification: IS 1893 (Part 1):2016 Clause 7.11.1: the drift of the design forces is checked as computed
sources.separation: IS 1893 (Part 1):2016 Clause 7.11.3: separation of R times the sum of the displacements of the two units, half of it where the floor levels match (SAEngine reading of the two parts of the clause)
sources.dampingCorrection: IS 1893 (Part 1):2016 Table 4 (alpha 9 C9b): the spectrum's multiplying factors for damping other than 5 %: 0 % 3.2, 2 % 1.4, 5 % 1.0, 7 % 0.9, 10 % 0.8, 15 % 0.7, 20 % 0.6, 25 % 0.55, 30 % 0.5 (linear between; the project's damping ratio, Project Settings > Seismic)
sources.irregularities: IS 1893 (Part 1):2016 Tables 5 and 6; soft and weak storey: lateral stiffness or strength less than that of the storey above (ratio 1.0); mass: seismic weight over 2 times an adjacent storey's; geometry: plan dimension over 125 % of the storey below
sources.torsionIrregular: IS 1893 (Part 1):2016 Table 5 (i): Δmax over 1.2 Δmin at the two ends of the floor; as Δmax/Δavg of the two ends, 2(1.2)/(1 + 1.2) = 1.0909, and 1.4 (revise the configuration) gives 1.1667
sources.torsionAmplificationMax: IS 1893 (Part 1):2016: no amplification of the accidental torsion (1.0); a torsionally irregular building needs the 3D dynamic analysis of Table 5 (i)
sources.dynamicAnalysis: IS 1893 (Part 1):2016 Clause 7.7.1: dynamic analysis for every building except regular buildings below 15 m in zone II
sources.liveShare: IS 1893 (Part 1):2016 Clause 7.3.1, Table 10: 25 % of imposed loads up to 3.0 kN/m², 50 % above
sources.lateralForce.minimumShare: IS 1893 (Part 1):2016 Clause 7.2.2, Table 7: least design base shear 0.7 %, 1.1 %, 1.6 %, 2.4 % of W in zones II-V
sources.lateralForce.distribution: IS 1893 (Part 1):2016 Clause 7.6.3: Qi = VB Wi hi² / Σ Wj hj²
sources.minimumScale: IS 1893 (Part 1):2016 Clause 7.7.3: the dynamic base shear scaled up to the equivalent static VB (of Ta)
sources.designEccentricity: IS 1893 (Part 1):2016 Clause 7.8.2: design eccentricity edi = 1.5 esi + 0.05 bi or esi - 0.05 bi in the static torsion cases; the 3D model carries esi, the cases add 0.5 esi on its side; esi from the centres of mass and of rigidity, the rigidity estimated from the vertical members b d³ (SAEngine practice, alpha 9 C12)
sources.massParticipation: IS 1893 (Part 1):2016 Clause 7.7.5.2: modes to 90 % of the mass
sources.pgaFactor: IS 1893 (Part 1):2016 Clause 6.4.2: Z/2, the peak ground acceleration of the design basis earthquake
sources.verticalFactor: IS 1893 (Part 1):2016 Clause 6.4.6 (alpha 9 C9b): the vertical design acceleration two-thirds of the horizontal; as SAEngine's Ev = verticalFactor · a_h · D with a_h = Z/2 (the vertical response taken rigid, Sa/g = 1), in the combinations that carry Ev; 6.3.3.1 lists the structures that need it (cantilevers, long spans, zones IV and V): SAEngine applies it wherever Ev is used
sources.partitionWeight: SAEngine practice: partitions as dead load in the seismic weight
sources.periodUpperFactor: IS 1893 (Part 1):2016 Clause 7.6.2 and 7.7.3: VB is found with the approximate period Ta; a period from the modal analysis is not taken above it (1.0)
